title: LMS Migration Experience
summary: I supported the Absorb-to-Docebo migration through learning-structure setup, content and learning-plan configuration, UAT, learner support, documentation, and immediate post-launch reporting.

content.business_need: Move learning operations from Absorb into Docebo while rebuilding the structures, content relationships, learning plans, certifications, support processes, and reporting needed for employees, partners, and customers.
content.audience: Employees, partners, customers, and learning operations teams.
learning_objectives: Configure and validate learning structures, content, learning plans, catalogs, and certifications in Docebo.
Test employee, partner, and customer learner journeys before and around launch.
Document migration issues, retest fixes, and support learner-facing troubleshooting.
Build repeatable support and documentation workflows and support immediate post-launch reporting and action planning.
content.role: Instructional designer and LMS content administrator supporting setup, configuration, UAT, learner support, documentation, and post-launch operations during the Absorb-to-Docebo migration.
content.design_approach: I used the existing Absorb environment as a baseline, helped configure the corresponding Docebo learning structures, then tested the learner journeys and operational processes around them. My work connected platform setup, content administration, learner experience, support, and reporting rather than treating migration as a file-transfer exercise.
content.development_process: I helped set up learning structures, learning plans, content relationships, catalogs, certifications, and learner-facing assets in Docebo; participated in UAT for employee, partner, and customer experiences; documented and retested issues; supported the learner inbox; helped create support documentation and reusable customer-support email templates; and supported immediate post-launch reporting and action planning.
outcomes: Helped configure and validate Docebo learning structures, plans, content, certifications, and audience experiences.
Documented migration issues and supported triage and retesting across employee, partner, and customer journeys.
Supported learner inbox operations, repeatable support responses, documentation workflows, and immediate post-launch reporting and follow-up.

detail_sections.title: What I helped build in Docebo.

items.title: Learning plans

items.title: Certifications + renewals

items.title: Content + navigation

items.title: Issue triage
items.body: Documented problems, supported troubleshooting, and retested fixes as issues moved toward resolution.

detail_sections.title: What I helped establish for launch and immediate follow-up.
detail_sections.summary: Migration support continued after testing through learner communication, documentation, reporting, and action planning.

items.title: Inbox support
items.body: Helped respond to learner and customer issues as people entered the new Docebo environment.

items.title: Documentation + email templates
items.body: Helped document support processes and create reusable customer-support email templates for common migration questions.

items.title: Post-launch reporting
items.body: Supported immediate reporting and action planning so unresolved issues, exceptions, and follow-up work stayed visible.
